title: FLoat Life Fest 7
description:
Photos from the 7th Float Life Fest 
These photos were sorted fully autonomously using a series of image analysis heuristics that I built myself. 
They're sorted in descending order - Bangers, Good, Mid. The categorization is primarily evaluated by the level of 'in-focus' the subject is. 
Because this was binned by a piece of software, there are mistakes, so please scroll through all the albums. 
Shot on my personal cameras and cameras from Armor-Dilloz
